claims.value: TMTpro 16-plex: 126 = carrier (absent in No-carrier runs), 127C empty (no row), 127N..134N = 14 single-cell channels
claims.evidence: Results: channel 126 served as the CPC, 127C left empty, last 14 channels single-cell channels; No-carrier runs have no CPC

claims.value: E. coli/Human/yeast relative amounts per channel, e.g. 127N 50/100/50 ... 134N 1/100/99
claims.evidence: Read from the bar labels of Fig. 1a (image); no text/table equivalent located

claims.value: carrier proteome H/EY/HEY/none, carrier level 14-434x, 50/100/200 pg, AGC 50/300 %, MS2 resolution 30K-120K, NCE 26-38 %
claims.evidence: All 240 deposited RAW names matched one-to-one to Supplementary Data 2 RawFiles rows

claims.value: Replicates column of Supplementary Data 2 (1/2; 1 where blank for 20200827 files)
claims.evidence: Table labels it 'Replicates'; biological vs technical not stated

claims.value: Orbitrap Exploris 480; TCEP/CAA; 10 ppm / 0.02 Da; Trypsin
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol, paper Methods, PD workflow (Precursor 10 ppm, Fragment 0.02 Da, Trypsin (Full), 1 missed cleavage)

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; TMTpro K and N-term fixed; Oxidation M variable
claims.evidence: PD workflow Static 1/2 and Peptide N-Terminus, Dynamic 2
PD scan-event filter Activation Type HCD
single-cell template requires single cell isolation protocol and cell identifier, which do not apply to diluted bulk peptide mixtures; comment[carrier channel] optional

limitations: Carrier channel species proportions (H/EY/HEY) and absolute carrier amounts not stated; carrier level (x) given only as factor
Channel composition amounts read from the Fig. 1a image, units relative (axis 0-200)
Collision energy NCE is given as % NCE per Supplementary Data 2; MS2 analyzer Orbitrap from instrument/PD filter FTMS, RAW headers not checked
pdResult parameters read from one file; assumed identical for all runs
Organism: three repeated columns; carrier rows with fewer species have empty trailing cells; produced by post-processing build output (build cannot emit per-row repeated columns)

Biological replicate for the 48 20200827 files is placeholder 1 (Replicates blank in Supplementary Data 2); sources are separated by date and condition; technical replicate 1 everywhere, reinjection not stated
No-carrier runs: 14 rows 127N-134N with the same composition as carrier runs is inferred
Lys-C and Trypsin both encoded; sdrf-tools reconcile reads only the first cleavage column and still flags Trypsin missing
Cell type/organ/disease not available for mixed lysate
Carrier-channel sample type left not available; only one pdResult workflow inspected (paper Methods give PD 2.4 settings for the whole study); all 1201 PRIDE files counted over 13 pages (240 RAW)
